items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Preserve containment: keep new public exposure, go-live, and security-sensitive releases blocked. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it introduces no new credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: security baseline covers 61 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident readiness, data exposure, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unknown. Compliance reports 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown; HTTPS checks exist for some sites but do not establish complete TLS control evidence. No compromise is evidenced, and no certification or clean bill of health is claimed. Risk severity: high for public launch and security-sensitive releases; medium for bounded reversible growth. Exact decision: retain the existing private launch and release gates, including SearchWoot private status and unsent rights outreach, and continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix. Do not create duplicate security work, retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.
